name: g4-apexpages-controller-evidence
salesforceExclusionReason: This fixture proves the local Visualforce controller model, including caller-provided addFields rejection and deterministic page sizing. It grants zero Salesforce parity credit.

source.content: @isTest private class G4ApexPagesControllerEvidenceTest { @isTest static void rows() { ApexPages.StandardSetController setController = new ApexPages.StandardSetController(new List<Account>()); Boolean pageSizeRejected = false; try { setController.setPageSize(1); } catch (VisualforceException expected) { pageSizeRejected = true; } System.assertEquals(true, pageSizeRejected); Boolean setRejected = false; try { setController.addFields(new List<String>{'Name'}); } catch (SObjectException expected) { setRejected = true; } System.assertEquals(true, setRejected); ApexPages.StandardController standard = new ApexPages.StandardController(new Account(Name = 'Standard Controller')); Boolean standardRejected = false; try { standard.addFields(new List<String>{'Name'}); } catch (SObjectException expected) { standardRejected = true; } System.assertEquals(true, standardRejected); } }
